banner.title: THE MotP PARA-ELEMENTAL PLANES - printed pp. 51-54, the four planes in one round: Smoke, Magma, Ooze and Ice - the survival, the pockets, the encounter check, the mapping doctrines, and the features (the archoments and Cryonax of Ice).
banner.provenance: verified against printed pp. 51-54 of the uploaded motp.pdf OCR; the para-planes pin by mapping onto the R568-R571 major-plane pins (Smoke as Air, Magma and Ooze as Water and Fire, Ice as Earth) with the MotP's own differences carried explicitly.

consts.name: ddaParaPlaneCount
consts.comment: the four para-planes between the majors: Smoke where Air meets Fire, Magma where Fire meets Earth, Ooze where Earth meets Water, Ice where Water meets Air - minor because harder to reach, fewer powers, less varied, and transitional.

consts.name: ddaParaEncounterDenom
consts.comment: travelers in any of the four para-planes have a 1-in-20 chance of an encounter, checked every eight TRUE hours; roll: 1-20 elemental pocket, 21-00 creature encounter - no outstanding phenomena, only small local variations.

consts.name: ddaParaSmokeVisionYards
consts.comment: the vision ladder: Smoke the best at about 30 yards; Magma and Ooze limited to touch range without x-ray devices; Ice varies 10-20 yards with the translucency.

consts.name: ddaParaIceColdDieSides
consts.comment: the Ice survival: the unprotected suffer 1d6 cold damage per round, reduced to 1d6 per TURN when well-protected or wrapped in furs, negated by cold protection; the trapped are incredibly well preserved - no incarceration damage.

consts.name: ddaParaPocketSplitPct
consts.comment: each para-plane contains equal pockets from the two adjacent majors (50/50): Smoke takes air or fire, Magma fire or earth, Ooze water or earth, Ice water or air - with the lair chances per pocket type.

consts.name: ddaParaChartDieSides
consts.comment: the para-elemental encounter chart is a d8+d12 roll (2-20): 2 the para-element prince of evil, 9 the para-elementals, 14 the adjacent-major genie - the parenthetical suggestions per plane guide the DM.

consts.name: ddaParaGuideFightPct
consts.comment: the para-elemental guides: gruff, bribed as the majors, but plane-appealing gifts (smoke essence, an ice-carving) double the service duration with a 50% chance they fight with the party.

bools.name: ddaParaSurvivalSmoke
bools.comment: Smoke survival: asphyxiation is the danger, the particles and gases unbreathable - airy smoke and smoke breathing negate it; only breath-eliminating devices permit long adventures.

bools.name: ddaParaSurvivalMagmaOoze
bools.comment: Magma treats the traveler to Fire's heat and flame with breathing as in a hot liquid - protection plus element-breathing needed; Ooze has Water's drowning - water breathing works without modification.

bools.name: ddaParaNativeImmunity
bools.comment: para-elementals are immune to their home para-plane and its related major planes while in the inner planes (the magma troll immune to flame and magma, unrestricted in Earth); Ice natives move and fight in Ice, Water and Air, immune to cold and ice.

bools.name: ddaParaMovementMap
bools.comment: the movement mapping: Magma and Ooze as Water (falling included), Smoke as Air, Ice as Earth save any Strength moves through the soft ice; combat maps identically (Smoke hardly restricted, Ice as Earth).

bools.name: ddaParaMagicMap
bools.comment: the magic mapping: Smoke unrestricted; Magma casts as through water if the caster can see, Fire's effects on created material; Ooze suffers the underwater strictures; Ice solid as Earth - created fires work but melt the ice which extinguishes them.

bools.name: ddaParaArchomentRule
bools.comment: no single leader per plane, but ice lords, slime barons, magma generals and smoke dukes vie for control; the mightiest are Demi-Powers with NO Greater Powers above them - Cryonax of Ice the described one, with Ehkahk, Chlimbia and Bwimb named.
